seoTitle: Wide to Long Reshaper: Unpivot a Table and Back
metaDescription: Stack columns such as one per year into name and value rows, keeping id columns, or spread long data back to wide. Free CSV tool.
intro: Melts a wide table into long format or casts a long table back to wide.
why:
Charts, databases and statistics tools like long data: one row per observation. Spreadsheets often hold wide data with a column per year or month. Choose the identifier columns to keep and the rest are stacked into a name column and a value column.

The reverse mode needs a name column and a value column and creates one column per distinct name; two rows with the same identifiers and name are an error rather than a silent overwrite.
howTo: Paste the CSV and list the identifier columns.
Choose wide to long or long to wide.
Name the new columns, or set the name and value columns for the reverse.

faq.a: All except the identifiers, unless you list columns to stack.
No, text is carried over unchanged.

faq.q: What if long to wide has duplicates?
faq.a: You get an error naming the name.
